actions.name: text_to_audio
actions.description: Synthesize text into audio with the MiniMax T2A v2 API.

text.description: Text to synthesize into audio. Must be shorter than 10,000 characters.

stream.description: Set to false for the non-streaming connector action.

language_boost.description: Language or dialect hint that improves pronunciation. Set auto to let MiniMax detect it.

output_format.description: How MiniMax delivers the audio. url returns a download link valid for 24 hours, while hex, the MiniMax default, inlines hex-encoded audio, so prefer url for long text.

voice_id.description: Identifier of the system, cloned, or generated voice to speak with. Required unless timbre_weights mixes voices.

speed.description: Speech speed where higher values speak faster. MiniMax defaults to 1.

vol.description: Speech volume where higher values are louder. MiniMax defaults to 1.

pitch.description: Speech pitch offset where 0 keeps the original pitch.

emotion.description: Emotion of the synthesized speech. MiniMax picks one from the text when omitted.

text_normalization.description: Whether to normalize Chinese and English text, which reads digits better at the cost of latency.

latex_read.description: Whether to read LaTeX formulas wrapped in double dollar signs. Chinese only, and it forces language_boost to Chinese.

voice_id.description: Identifier of the voice to mix.

weight.description: Weight of this voice, where a higher value sounds more like it.

items.description: One voice and its weight in the mixed timbre.

timbre_weights.description: Voices to blend into one mixed timbre. Leave voice_setting.voice_id empty when mixing voices.

tone.description: Pronunciation rules written as original/replacement, for example omg/oh my god. Replacements accept plain text, parenthesized pinyin with tone digits, parenthesized IPA, or Japanese kana.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the generated audio in hertz. MiniMax defaults to 32000.

bitrate.description: Bitrate of the generated audio, applied to mp3 output only. MiniMax defaults to 128000.

format.description: Format of the generated audio. MiniMax defaults to mp3, pcmu_raw and pcmu_wav are G.711 mu-law, and opus is Ogg/Opus.

channel.description: Number of audio channels where 1 is mono and 2 is stereo. MiniMax defaults to 1.

pitch.description: Voice depth where -100 is deepest and 100 is brightest.

intensity.description: Voice intensity where -100 is strongest and 100 is softest.

timbre.description: Voice timbre where -100 is fullest and 100 is crispest.

sound_effects.description: Sound effect to apply. Only one effect can be active at a time.

voice_modify.description: MiniMax voice effect settings. Non-streaming synthesis supports mp3, wav, and flac output.

subtitle_enable.description: Whether MiniMax also generates a subtitle file and returns its download link.

subtitle_type.description: Granularity of the generated subtitle timestamps. MiniMax defaults to sentence.

inputSchema.description: Request body for MiniMax text-to-audio synthesis.

audio.description: Hex-encoded audio, or a download URL when output_format is url.

status.description: Synthesis status where 1 means synthesizing and 2 means finished.

subtitle_file.description: Download link for the generated subtitle file.

anyOf.description: Synthesized audio payload. MiniMax may return null.

data.description: Synthesized audio payload. MiniMax may return null.

audio_sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the generated audio.

audio_size.description: Size of the generated audio in bytes.

audio_format.description: Format of the generated audio, for example mp3, pcm, or flac.

audio_channel.description: Number of audio channels where 1 is mono and 2 is stereo.

invisible_character_ratio.description: Share of invalid characters in the submitted text.

usage_characters.description: Number of billable characters used by this synthesis.

word_count.description: Spoken word count covering Chinese characters, digits, and letters, but not punctuation.

extra_info.description: Additional information about the synthesized audio.

trace_id.description: MiniMax session identifier used when reporting an issue.

status_code.description: MiniMax status code where 0 indicates success.
